title: NumPy 1D Array Allocation & Element-Wise Arithmetic Simulator
description: Visual step-by-step trace of importing NumPy, allocating a 1D ndarray in contiguous memory, indexing elements, inspecting metadata (shape, size, ndim), and executing vectorized element-wise addition.

steps.explanation: Imports the numerical computing library NumPy with the standard alias 'np'.
np.array() converts the Python list into a contiguous 1D NumPy array with 5 integer elements.
Accesses element at negative index -1 (the final element): marks[-1] = 75.
Vectorized element-wise operation: +5 is added to every element across the array in parallel without a loop.
Prints the formatted string representation of the original marks array.
Prints the first mark retrieved by indexing.
Prints the last mark retrieved via negative indexing.
Prints the updated array after element-wise addition.
steps.output:
Marks: [70 80 65 90 75]
First mark: 70
Last mark: 75
Updated marks: [75 85 70 95 80]

steps.explanation: marks.shape returns (5,), indicating a 1D array of 5 elements.
steps.output:

Updated marks: [75 85 70 95 80]
Shape: (5,)

steps.explanation: marks.size returns 5, the total number of elements in the array.
